answer_2.quote: We first employ automatic metrics to understand the generated data. To achieve this, we use training set as reference and calculate BLEU , ROUGE-L , METEOR  and BertScore .

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation centered around two questions: (1) "Can the utterance imply the intent?" (2) "If yes, is it conveyed explicitly?" We first sample 180 utterances containing 60 from original, 60 from negation and 60 from implicature. 8 human annotators from our internal team (with fluent English skills) provided binary answers for these two questions in a sequential manner.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked two questions: 1. Determine whether an utterance may imply a given intent (binary answer). 2. If yes, determine whether the utterance conveys the intent explicitly (binary answer).
